annotator: Codex, one annotator, from the whole body, before any prediction. Not expert consensus (round #2957, fresh-gold.json).
boundaryRule: One event is one concrete action. A later step in one case (a motion after a filing) is a new event. An article with no confirmed event (an advance forecast, a round-up) is alone in its event.

source.name: WCEP-10, test split with dense retrieval (allenai/wcep_dense_max, revision fccb66b6d8ecc56df165f9eaf9d105188ad54e90), rows 200 to 219
source.licence: The dataset card says "license: other". The articles belong to their publishers and are not in this repository; this repository holds only row and article indexes and our labels.
source.attribution: Demian Gholipour Ghalandari, Chris Hokamp, Nghia The Pham, John Glover and Georgiana Ifrim. 2020. A Large-Scale Multi-Document Summarization Dataset from the Wikipedia Current Events Portal. In Proceedings of ACL 2020. Dense retrieval copy by the Allen Institute for AI.

weaknesses: WCEP gives no dates. The runner gives every article one publish day.
The datasets-server API serves the latest revision of the dataset. A new revision shows as changed texts.
